leaf.tested_scope: Only the committed final_info.json evidence package at the public default branch, not other run files or repository history.
leaf.observation: The committed JSON contains per-dataset means, standard errors, and the underlying per-run arrays for final_train_loss, best_val_loss, total_train_time, and avg_inference_tokens_per_second. Shakespeare has five per-run values per metric; enwik8 and text8 each have one. The file itself contains no execution/run identifier, seed identifiers, input/data hashes, code revision, model/checkpoint hash, ordered per-step trace, verifier identity, or source-to-result binding fields.
leaf.inference: The Git blob gives immutable artifact identity and scheduled Chat can inspect the aggregate package without rerunning CUDA training, but the package is not execution-complete replay evidence: it cannot by itself verify which exact inputs/code/runtime produced the values or replay row-level execution. It is therefore useful as a zero-cost post-run aggregate evidence package only, with provenance/replay closure still unresolved.
leaf.uncertainty: Sibling files in the same committed run directory may bind config, seed, code/result identity, or traces; this slice did not inspect them.
